name: Why is proper finishing important for garage drywall repair, even if it's just a garage?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper finishing important for garage drywall repair, even if it's just a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper finishing of garage drywall repair is important for both aesthetics and durability. A smooth, even finish ensures that any paint applied adheres correctly and looks uniform, preventing visible patches. More critically, a well-finished repair seals the drywall, providing better resistance to moisture and pests, extending the life of the repair, and contributing to the overall integrity of the garage's interior, even in a functional space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper finishing ensures aesthetic consistency, better paint adhesion, and enhanced durability against moisture and pests, even in a garage.
